- `fillFuelTank`: Add fuel to the tank (up to 50 gallons).
- `gallon_to_liter` / `liter_to_gallon`: Convert between units.
- `get_current_speed`: Report the current speed.
- `get_outside_temperature_from_google` / `get_outside_temperature_from_weather_com`: Fetch outside temperature from either source.
